focus_areas: Severe text gibberish on the main storefront sign.
Structural coherence and boundary sharpness of the graffiti on the upper wall.
Geometric integrity at the junction of the straight door frame and curved window.
Distinctness of individual baked goods on the shelves (avoiding melting/fusion).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the sign - it is likely gibberish, not legible French. Verify the graffiti on the upper wall for melting artifacts and lack of distinct boundaries. Examine the junction between the straight door frame and the curved window for geometric warping or structural inconsistencies. Ensure the baked goods in the window are distinct objects and not a textured blur.
image_description: A street-level view of a commercial bakery storefront. The facade features a large, curved glass display window filled with shelves of baked goods illuminated by warm interior lighting. To the left is a glass door entrance with posted notices. Above the window is a white sign with stylized text that appears to be gibberish or nonsensical characters rather than legible words. The building exterior appears to be stucco or painted masonry. There is colorful graffiti on the upper wall section above the shop signage which appears structurally incoherent and blends into the wall texture.
